edits.new_content:
version: 2
metrics:
- name: day_off_index
  label: Day-Off Index
  description: 'Average year-over-year change, in percent, of US Google searches for call in sick, sick
    day and day off work over the configured window (canonical: 1-14 Nov 2026 vs 2-15 Nov 2025). 50 =
    searches up 50% on average. Never report it alone: always with its breakdown (group by day_off_index_window__breakdown,
    or query day_off_index_term_change by day_off_index_term__term).'
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: day_off_index_measure
- name: day_off_index_term_change
  label: Day-Off Index, change by phrase
  description: 'The breakdown: one phrase''s year-over-year change in average weekly search interest,
    in percent. Group by day_off_index_term__term.'
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: term_pct_change
- name: day_off_index_term_current
  label: Search interest, current window
  description: A phrase's average weekly search interest over the current window (0-100 on that phrase's
    own scale). Group by day_off_index_term__term.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: term_current_avg_interest
- name: day_off_index_term_prior
  label: Search interest, a year earlier
  description: A phrase's average weekly search interest over the same weeks a year earlier (0-100 on
    that phrase's own scale). Group by day_off_index_term__term.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: term_prior_avg_interest
- name: signal_value
  label: Signal value
  description: Daily value of a signal. Always group by signal_day__source and signal_day__signal; never
    add across signals.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: signal_value_measure
- name: day_off_mentions
  label: Day-off mentions
  description: Posts saying someone is taking time off (any reason), summed over seed phrases. Group by
    signal_day__source.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: signal_value_measure
  filter: '{{ Dimension(''signal_day__signal'') }} = ''posts:day_off''

    '
- name: day_off_mentions_gta
  label: Day-off mentions that say GTA
  description: Posts saying someone is taking time off that also mention GTA.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: signal_value_measure
  filter: '{{ Dimension(''signal_day__signal'') }} = ''posts:day_off_gta''

    '
- name: gta_share_of_day_off_talk
  label: GTA share of day-off talk
  description: Day-off posts that mention GTA, as a share of all day-off posts. A fraction (0 to 1). Thursday-is-chattier
    effects cancel out.
  type: ratio
  type_params:
    numerator: day_off_mentions_gta
    denominator: day_off_mentions
- name: gta_wiki_pageviews
  label: GTA 6 Wikipedia pageviews
  description: Daily user pageviews of the English Wikipedia article Grand Theft Auto VI. The hype line.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: signal_value_measure
  filter: '{{ Dimension(''signal_day__signal'') }} = ''pageviews:grand_theft_auto_vi''

    '

- name: world_productivity
  label: World productivity
  description: 'Metric 2, GTA 5 to GTA 6. World real output in one year, in the measure''s unit: output_per_worker is World Bank GDP per person employed (constant 2021 PPP $), output_per_person is World Bank GDP per capita (constant 2015 US$). Always group by world_productivity_key__measure and world_productivity_key__data_year; never add across measures or years.'
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: value

- name: world_productivity_change_since_gta_v
  label: World productivity, change since GTA 5
  description: 'Metric 2, GTA 5 to GTA 6. Real change in world productivity since GTA 5''s launch year (2013), in percent. Group by world_productivity_key__measure and world_productivity_key__data_year. The headline year is 2026 (GTA 6) for output_per_person, an estimate carried by IMF world real GDP growth, and the latest published year for output_per_worker (2026 reads NULL: unavailable).'
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: pct_change_since_gta_v

- name: world_output_produced
  label: World output made while waiting for GTA 6
  description: 'Metric 3, everything humanity made while waiting for GTA 6. World real output (World Bank
    NY.GDP.MKTP.KD) made over the days asked for. With no group-by it is the headline: everything made from
    GTA 5''s release (17 Sep 2013) to the day before GTA 6 (18 Nov 2026), 4,811 days. Constant 2015 US$;
    2026 is an IMF-based estimate; never add cumulative output across days.'
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: daily_output

- name: world_output_cumulative
  label: World output since GTA 5, running total
  description: Metric 3. Running total of world real output since GTA 5's release, as of each day. Group
    by world_output_day__output_day or metric_time; at week or month grain it reads the period's last day.
    Constant 2015 US$; 2026 is an IMF-based estimate; never add cumulative output across days.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: cumulative_output

- name: world_output_per_second
  label: World output per second
  description: 'Metric 3. The rate the world makes things at: one day''s world real output / 86,400. Only
    meaningful by day: group by world_output_day__output_day (or metric_time__day). A yearly average spread
    evenly; nobody measures GDP by the second. Constant 2015 US$; 2026 is an IMF-based estimate; never add
    cumulative output across days.'
  type: derived
  type_params:
    expr: world_output_produced / 86400
    metrics:
    - name: world_output_produced

- name: wait_milestone_output
  label: World output made by each milestone
  description: Metric 3. World real output made since GTA 5's release by the day before each milestone.
    Group by milestone__title and milestone__event_date (milestone__is_editorial = true for the chart). Milestones
    are editorial picks, not a ranking. Constant 2015 US$; 2026 is an IMF-based estimate; never add cumulative
    output across days.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: output_by_then

- name: wait_milestone_share
  label: Share of the wait's output made by each milestone
  description: Metric 3. wait_milestone_output over the whole wait's output (0 to 1). Group by milestone.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: share_of_wait_output

- name: wait_milestone_days_to_gta_6
  label: Days from each milestone to GTA 6
  description: Metric 3. Days from the milestone to GTA 6's release day (19 Nov 2026). Group by milestone.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: days_to_gta_6

- name: github_release_day_change
  label: 'GitHub on GTA 6 release day: PRs opened'
  description: Metric 4 headline. Change, in percent, of pull requests opened on GitHub on GTA 6's release
    day (Thu 19 Nov 2026, UTC) against the Thursday before (12 Nov 2026). -4 = 4% fewer PRs opened. Report
    it with its breakdown (group by github_release_day__breakdown, or query github_activity_change by github_activity__activity),
    which also gives PRs merged and commits.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: github_release_day_change_measure

- name: github_activity_change
  label: GitHub release day, change by activity
  description: 'Metric 4 breakdown: one activity''s release-day count against the same weekday a week before,
    in percent. Group by github_activity__activity.'
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: github_activity_pct_change

- name: github_activity_release_day
  label: GitHub activity on release day
  description: Metric 4. An activity's count on release day (UTC). Group by github_activity__activity.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: github_activity_release_day_count

- name: github_activity_baseline
  label: GitHub activity on a normal day
  description: Metric 4. An activity's count on the same weekday a week before release day (the median when
    the baseline spans more weeks). Group by github_activity__activity.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: github_activity_baseline_count

- name: github_activity_count
  label: GitHub activity per day
  description: 'Metrics 4 and 6. PRs opened, PRs merged or commits on GitHub per UTC day (GitHub Search
    API total_count). Always group by github_day__activity: never add across activities. NULL is unavailable,
    never zero.'
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: github_activity_count_measure

- name: github_activity_change_wow
  label: GitHub activity, change on the same weekday a week earlier
  description: Metrics 4 and 6. A day's count against the same weekday 7 days earlier, in percent, per activity.
    Group by metric_time__day and github_day__activity (filter github_day__weekday_name = 'Thursday' for
    the Thursdays around release day). NULL when either day is missing.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: github_activity_wow_pct_change

- name: github_activity_count_week_before
  label: GitHub activity, same weekday a week earlier
  description: Metrics 4 and 6. The count on the same weekday 7 days earlier, per activity. Group by metric_time__day
    and github_day__activity.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: github_activity_prior_week_count
